# Roku
> Roku provides streaming devices, smart TV software, free and premium streaming content, and support resources for setup, troubleshooting, and account management.

Roku’s website spans consumer streaming products, the Roku Channel, account and billing help, developer resources for channel and app creation, and support articles for devices, remotes, TVs, audio products, and smart home devices.

## Products
- [Streaming Players](https://www.roku.com/products/players): Roku streaming players and sticks for adding streaming apps and live TV to televisions.
- [Roku TV](https://www.roku.com/products/roku-tv): Smart TVs powered by Roku OS from multiple television brands and screen sizes.
- [Roku Audio](https://www.roku.com/products/audio): Soundbars, speakers, and subwoofers designed to improve TV and music audio.
- [Roku Smart Home](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home): Cameras, video doorbells, lights, plugs, and home monitoring devices managed through Roku.
- [Accessories](https://www.roku.com/products/accessories): Remotes, cables, mounts, and other accessories for Roku devices and TVs.
- [Compare Streaming Players](https://www.roku.com/products/compare): Side-by-side comparison of Roku streaming player models and capabilities.

## Streaming and Entertainment
- [The Roku Channel](https://www.roku.com/the-roku-channel): Free and premium movies, shows, live TV, and Roku Originals in one service.
- [What to Watch](https://www.roku.com/whats-on): Editorial recommendations and discovery pages for movies, shows, and streaming entertainment.
- [Live TV Zone](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/live-tv): Live TV discovery and programming available through Roku experiences.
- [Featured Free](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/featured-free): Free streaming picks and featured content available without subscription fees.
- [Roku Originals](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/roku-originals): Original series and exclusive programming available through the Roku Channel.
- [Kids & Family](https://www.roku.com/whats-on/kids-and-family): Family-friendly streaming recommendations and programming collections for children and parents.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://support.roku.com/): Main support portal for troubleshooting, setup, account, billing, and product help.
- [Set up your Roku device](https://support.roku.com/category/115001078228): Setup articles for players, TVs, remotes, networking, and activation.
- [Fix a problem](https://support.roku.com/category/115001078248): Troubleshooting help for playback, connectivity, remote, and device performance issues.
- [Account, payments & subscriptions](https://support.roku.com/category/360002101573): Help with Roku accounts, billing, subscriptions, and payment methods.
- [Using your Roku device](https://support.roku.com/category/115001078288): Guides for navigation, features, settings, and everyday device usage.
- [Roku Smart Home support](https://support.roku.com/category/4408982999575): Help articles for cameras, lights, plugs, and other smart home products.

## Device and Feature Help
- [Remote controls](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200353): Support for pairing, troubleshooting, and using Roku remote controls.
- [Audio devices](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200374): Help for Roku soundbars, speakers, wireless audio, and sound settings.
- [Roku TV](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200394): Support articles specific to Roku TV models, settings, and troubleshooting.
- [Channels & viewing](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200414): Help with channel installation, playback, search, and viewing options.
- [Mobile app](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200434): Guidance for using the Roku mobile app and related features.
- [Accessibility](https://support.roku.com/category/360001200454): Accessibility features and assistive options for Roku devices and services.

## Account and Subscriptions
- [Create or update your Roku account](https://support.roku.com/article/208755708): Instructions for creating and managing Roku account details.
- [Manage subscriptions billed through Roku](https://support.roku.com/article/208756478): How to review, change, or cancel subscriptions purchased through Roku.
- [Update payment method](https://support.roku.com/article/208755938): Steps for changing billing information associated with a Roku account.
- [PIN preference settings](https://support.roku.com/article/208755628): Configure purchase and parental control PIN settings for your account.
- [Activation issues](https://support.roku.com/category/115001078228): Support resources for activation, linking, and initial device setup problems.

## Developers
- [Developer Home](https://developer.roku.com/): Entry point for Roku developer tools, documentation, and publishing resources.
- [Developer Documentation](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/getting-started/roku-dev-prog.md): Overview of Roku development concepts, tools, and platform basics.
- [SceneGraph Developer Guide](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/core-concepts/scenegraph.md): Core UI framework guidance for building Roku channels and apps.
- [BrightScript Language Reference](https://developer.roku.com/docs/references/brightscript/language/brightscript-language-reference.md): Reference documentation for Roku’s BrightScript programming language.
- [Component Reference](https://developer.roku.com/docs/references/scenegraph/index.md): Reference for SceneGraph components, nodes, and UI elements.
- [Publishing Overview](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/publishing/publishing-overview.md): Requirements and process for packaging and publishing Roku channels.

## APIs and SDKs
- [Developer API Reference](https://developer.roku.com/docs/references/api-reference.md): Reference entry point for Roku platform APIs and developer interfaces.
- [Advertising Framework](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/advertising/integrating-roku-advertising-framework.md): Integration guide for Roku advertising and monetization in channels.
- [Direct Publisher](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/direct-publisher/index.md): Tools and documentation for feed-based channel creation and publishing.
- [Search and Discovery](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/discovery/search-integration.md): Guidance for integrating Roku search and content discovery metadata.
- [Billing and In-channel Products](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/monetization/in-channel-products.md): Monetization documentation for purchases and subscriptions inside Roku channels.
- [Sample Channels](https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/getting-started/code-samples.md): Example projects and sample code for common Roku app patterns.

## Smart Home
- [Roku Smart Home](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home): Product hub for Roku cameras, lights, plugs, and home monitoring devices.
- [Smart Home Support](https://support.roku.com/category/4408982999575): Troubleshooting and setup help for Roku smart home products.
- [Indoor Cameras](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/cameras): Roku indoor and outdoor camera product information and options.
- [Video Doorbells](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/video-doorbells): Smart doorbell products with video monitoring and alerts.
- [Lights](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/lights): Smart bulbs, strips, and lighting products for connected home control.
- [Plugs](https://www.roku.com/products/smart-home/plugs): Smart plug products for controlling household devices remotely.

## News and Company
- [Blog](https://www.roku.com/blog): Roku blog with product news, streaming updates, and company announcements.
- [Press](https://newsroom.roku.com/): Official newsroom with press releases, media resources, and corporate announcements.
- [About Roku](https://www.roku.com/about): Company overview, mission, and background information about Roku.
- [Careers](https://www.roku.com/jobs): Job openings and employment information across Roku teams and locations.
- [Investors](https://www.roku.com/investor): Investor relations information, filings, and financial updates.
- [Partner with Roku](https://www.roku.com/partners): Information for business, platform, and advertising partnerships with Roku.
